verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automation that runs in the background. Continuous monitoring, alerts and evidence collection run on their own, and AI risk auto-scoring is configurable. Users can also build ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts in the AI Editor and trigger them automatically from external events via webhooks. Most of this evidence is headline-level doc claims rather than detailed configuration guides. Missing for 10: documentation of scheduling or trigger options beyond webhooks, a general-purpose automation builder outside ingestion and AI scoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run unattended.
